title: Ensure default repository access is restricted
description: Blanket grants are the quietest way for access to spread: nobody requests them, nobody reviews them, and they apply to accounts created long after the decision was made. Access should be granted deliberately, to named people or groups.
remediation: Project settings -> Project permissions: clear the default permission granted to all licensed users, or reduce it to Read, and grant Write/Admin to specific groups instead. To remove anonymous access, uncheck "Public access" at Repository settings -> Repository details and at Project settings -> Project details. For instances that intentionally publish code, set allowPublicRepositories: true in scm-bench's config.
